description: This Java source file defines a final class `SudoRetrieveThings` which represents a command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class is used internally to retrieve multiple 'Thing' entities based on a list of Thing IDs without authorization. It includes methods for constructing the command, parsing from JSON, and serializing to JSON payload, along with metadata annotations and constants related to command type and JSON structure.

classes.name: SudoRetrieveThings
classes.description: Represents a command to retrieve multiple Things by their IDs within the Eclipse Ditto framework. The class includes fields for Thing IDs and optional field selectors, allowing internal services to fetch Things without authorization, and supports JSON serialization/deserialization.
